title: Minecraft Wiki version index (Java Edition current release)
content_excerpt: Version index lists Java Edition 26.3 as the current release and 26.4 Snapshot 6 as the latest snapshot.
evidence_notes: Used to fix the target version for the knowledge layer. The 26.3 stable release was confirmed on 2026-11-01 by the Minecraft Wiki version index and by independent plugin compatibility listings that report 26.3 as the newest supported Java version.
notes: Snapshot 26.4 is explicitly out of scope as a target version.
